title: Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol using DNeasy® UltraClean® Microbial Kit
author: Md Sahadat Ali
materials: provides optimal DNA yield and purity. Note

steps.title: Collect Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Measure the culture OD600 and confirm it is approximately 0.7. Transfer 1.8 mL of the 24‑hour LB broth culture into a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds, then carefully decant the supernatant. Repeat centrifugation at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds and remove any remaining supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Lyse Cells with Beads and SL
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 µL PowerBead® Solution and vortex gently. Transfer the suspension to a PowerBead® Tube, add 50 µL Solution SL (preheat at 55 °C if precipitated), secure the tube horizontally in a vortex adapter, and vortex at maximum speed for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove Cell Debris
steps.instruction: Ensure the PowerBead® tubes rotate freely, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds. Transfer the clear supernatant (≈300–350 µL) to a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Remove Inhibitors
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Inhibitor Removal Solution (IRS) to the supernatant, vortex for 5 seconds, incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 minute, and carefully transfer the resulting supernatant to a new 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL SB solution to the supernatant and vortex for 5 seconds. Load 700 µL of this mixture into an MB Spin Column, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds, and discard the flow‑through. Repeat the loading, centrifugation, and discard steps until the entire sample has been processed (typically 2–3 loads).

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Column Binding (CB) Solution to the MB Spin Column and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds. Discard the flow‑through, then centrifuge again for 1 minute at 10,000 × g to remove residual CB solution.

steps.title: Elute DNA and Store
steps.instruction: Transfer the MB Spin Column to a new 2 mL collection tube, add 50 µL autoclaved Double DI (DDI) water directly onto the center of the filter membrane (instead of Solution EB), centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds to elute DNA, discard the column, and store the eluted DNA at –80 °C.
